overall_reason: The deploy card runs on untinted greys with a near-black #1f1f1f primary and green, grey and red status icons, but a violet-to-pink 'Ask AI' pill adds a second accent with no source in the card.

score.reason: T-PALETTE-ROLES finds two competing accents (the black Deploy button and the violet-pink pill) and T-COLOUR-SOURCE finds no source for the violet; the neutral base and status colours otherwise hold their roles.

findings.title: One accent across the page, never two (unless a declared full-palette posture)
findings.where: span.st-ai 'Ask AI' in the third row, 1440 and 375, tiles/1440-00.png lower right of the card
findings.evidence: The palette table lists one gradient on span.st-ai with stops #8b5cf6 and #ec4899, and a third shadow recipe, rgba(168,85,247,0.4) 0 0 12px. The card's primary action, 'Deploy', is #1f1f1f. The sweep's gradient, glow and look_family (violet-gradient, 3 of 3 tells) hits all land on this one element.
findings.before: A violet-to-pink gradient pill with a violet glow sits in a grey card, beside the red failed icon.
findings.after: One accent: 'Ask AI' as a secondary control in the card's own ink and grey surface, or in the single accent the product defines.
findings.why: The pill outranks the Deploy button and the red failure state in its row, so the eye lands on a feature promotion instead of the failed deploy.

findings.title: Colour has a source
findings.evidence: No other element in the card uses hues 265 to 360: the chromatic area at 1440 is 0.14%, all of it in the 270-360 bands from this pill. Nothing in the composition (a logo, a product mark, imagery) carries violet or pink.
findings.after: A colour traced to the product's own brand or design system, or no colour at all for this control.
findings.why: A hue that appears once with no source reads as a default added for 'AI', not a choice for this product.

strengths: The status icons keep fixed meanings: a green globe for live, a grey spinner for building and a red cross for failed, each with its own shape.
The base is one untinted grey family on white with a near-black primary button.
not_investigated: T-DARK-MODE: the page renders light; the stylesheet has a dark class theme that the capture did not render, so dark mode is not verified
brand authority: the run has no 00-contract.md, so no brand colours were available for T-COLOUR-SOURCE; sources were traced from the composition itself
contrast and focus: owned by the sweep (A11-001, A11-003) and not restated here
